facts.text: John and Max had a camping trip last summer where they hiked, swam, and made great memories.

evidence.quote: Max and I had a blast on our camping trip last summer. We hiked, swam, and made great memories.

facts.text: John described the camping trip as a peaceful and awesome experience, involving time away from the noise and quality time.

evidence.quote: It was a really peaceful and awesome experience.
Being out in nature, away from all the noise and taking some quality time was great.

facts.text: John mentioned that the camping trip was a nice break from the everyday hustle and bustle.

facts.text: John described the camping trip as a way to restart his mind and spirit, and to remember the little things in life and savor peaceful moments.
